blurb: Guests visit the taproom to enjoy a variety of house-made draft beers including lagers, IPAs, sours, and barrel-aged stouts. They can also purchase 4-packs or bottles to take away. The taproom hosts rotating food pop-ups and allows guests to bring their own food; dogs are welcome on leash.
